faq.question: Can I apply to more than one scholarship from this list?
faq.answer: Usually, yes—these are separate USA scholarship listings, not one combined program. Apply to any that fit your profile, but check each official source for its own rules, required materials, and deadline.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Focus on award amount, deadline, study level, location fit, and any field tags such as education, STEM, medicine, or biology. Amounts and requirements vary by listing, so compare row by row instead of assuming the same criteria across the page.

faq.question: Are these scholarships only for Massachusetts residents?
faq.answer: Not always—Massachusetts is part of this filter slice, but eligibility can still differ by program. Some listings may also show different citizenship or residency labels, so verify the official criteria before you apply.
